title: Multi-SWT-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Reproduction Test Generation
title_zh: 多语言基准 Multi-SWT-Bench 介绍

paragraphs.en: Reproduction test generation translates a natural-language issue description into executable tests that fail on the original code and pass after the issue is resolved, providing executable evidence for verifying candidate patches. Existing benchmarks are constructed for individual programming languages, preventing a unified evaluation across diverse programming ecosystems. To address this limitation, we introduce Multi-SWT-Bench , a multilingual benchmark for reproduction test generation consisting of 1,963 instances across eight programming languages: Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C, and C++. Using this benchmark, we conduct an empirical study of state-of-the-art LLMs with four representative methods (MSWE-agent, MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code) and perform a failure analysis across programming languages. Our evaluation reveals a systematic language gap. Across every evaluated method and LLM, the success rate on Python exceeds the aggregate success rate across all languages, while C++ exhibits particularly low success rates. Our failure analysis identifies both language-specific challenges arising from repository testing conventions and cross-language challenges in inferring implicit setup requirements and preserving the target behavior through iterative revisions. These findings demonstrate the importance of multilingual evaluation and provide actionable directions for developing reproduction test generation methods that generalize across software ecosystems and reliably capture issue-specific behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 复现测试生成将自然语言的问题描述转化为可执行的测试用例：这些测试在原始代码上会失败，但在问题修复后通过，从而为验证候选补丁提供可执行证据。 现有的基准测试是针对单个编程语言构建的，这使得跨不同编程生态系统的统一评估无法实现。 为解决这一局限性，我们提出了 Multi-SWT-Bench——一个用于复现测试生成的多语言基准测试，包含八种编程语言（Python、Java、TypeScript、JavaScript、Go、Rust、C 和 C++）的 1,963 个实例。 基于该基准测试，我们对当前最先进的 LLM 进行了经验研究，采用了四种代表性方法（MSWE-agent、MOpenHands、Codex 和 Claude Code），并开展了跨编程语言的失败分析。 我们的评估揭示了一个系统性的语言差异问题。 在所有评估的方法和 LLM 中，Python 的成功率均高于所有语言的综合成功率，而 C++ 的成功率则特别低。 我们的失败分析发现，既有源于仓库测试惯例的语言特定挑战，也存在跨语言的挑战，例如推断隐式设置要求以及通过迭代修订保持目标行为。 这些研究结果凸显了多语言评估的重要性，并为开发能够跨软件生态系统泛化且可靠捕捉问题特定行为的复现测试生成方法提供了可行的方向。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents are increasingly capable of automating software engineering tasks, including repository-level issue resolution ( Mündler et al., 2024 ; Zan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . As these agents become more capable of generating candidate patches, reliably verifying their outputs is emerging as a central challenge in AI-assisted software engineering ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Reliable issue resolution requires not only generating a plausible patch but also determining whether it actually addresses the behavior described in the issue ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Testing provides a natural mechanism for such verification, yet existing test suites do not necessarily exercise the behavior targeted by a newly reported issue. Consequently, a candidate patch may pass all existing tests without actually resolving the reported problem ( Ye et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体在自动化软件工程任务方面的能力日益增强，包括在代码库层面解决issue（Mündler等，2024；Zan等，2025；Zhang等，2024）。 随着这些智能体生成候选补丁的能力不断增强，可靠地验证其输出结果正成为人工智能辅助软件工程领域的一项核心挑战（Lu等，2026）。 可靠的issue解决不仅需要生成一个看似合理的补丁，还需要判断该补丁是否真正解决了issue中描述的行为问题（Li等，2026）。 测试为此类验证提供了一种自然的机制，但现有的测试套件并不一定能覆盖新报告的issue所针对的行为。 因此，一个候选补丁可能通过所有现有测试，却并未真正解决所报告的问题（Ye等，2021；Yang等，2017）。

paragraphs.en: Reproduction tests address this verification gap by translating the behavior described in a natural-language issue report into executable checks that fail on the original code and pass once the issue is resolved ( Mündler et al., 2024 ; Ahmed et al., 2026 ) . By reliably reproducing the reported failure, they provide execution-based feedback for investigating the issue and diagnosing its cause ( Nashid et al., 2025 ) . Once a candidate patch is generated, these tests help determine whether the patch resolves the reported issue and, when retained in the test suite, detect future regressions that reintroduce the same problem ( Mündler et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks of reproduction test generation primarily focus on individual programming languages, such as Python ( Mündler et al., 2024 ; Ahmed et al., 2024 ) and Java ( Ahmed et al., 2026 ) , leaving unclear whether conclusions about the capabilities and relative effectiveness of different agents generalize across programming ecosystems. These ecosystems shape how tests are written, integrated, and executed, potentially exposing agents to different failure modes. Systematic multilingual evaluation is therefore needed to assess the generalizability of existing agents, distinguish shared bottlenecks from language-specific challenges, and identify transferable design principles.

paragraphs.en: We denote a codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} after applying a patch X X as ℛ ∘ X \mathcal{R}\circ X . Given a single test t t and a codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} , executing t t on ℛ \mathcal{R} results in either pass or fail. We define this execution as exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ) ∈ { P , F } \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})\in\{P,F\} , where P P and F F denote passing and failing outcomes, respectively. A generated test t t successfully reproduces issue I I on codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} if it fails on the original code (i.e., exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ) = F \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})=F ) but passes on the patched codebase (i.e., exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ∘ X ) = P \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R}\circ X)=P ). We refer to such a test as a fail-to-pass ( F → P F\rightarrow P ) test. For a generated test set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , we consider the issue successfully reproduced if 𝒯 \mathcal{T} contains at least one F → P F\rightarrow P test and all generated tests pass on the patched codebase.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将应用补丁 X 后的代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R} 表示为 ℛ ∘ X \mathcal{R}\circ X。 给定单个测试 t 和代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R}，在 ℛ \mathcal{R} 上执行 t 的结果只能是通过或失败。 我们将此执行定义为 exec⁡(t,ℛ)∈{P,F} \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})\in\{P,F\}，其中 P 和 F 分别表示通过和失败的结果。 如果生成的测试 t 在原始代码上失败（即 exec⁡(t,ℛ)=F \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})=F），但在补丁后的代码库上通过（即 exec⁡(t,ℛ∘X)=P \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R}\circ X)=P），则 t 成功复现了代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R} 中的问题 I。 我们将此类测试称为“失败转通过”（F→P F\rightarrow P）测试。 对于一个生成的测试集 𝒯 \mathcal{T}，如果 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 至少包含一个 F→P F\rightarrow P 测试，且所有生成的测试在补丁后的代码库上均通过，则我们认为该问题已成功复现。

sents.zh: 我们将应用补丁 X 后的代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R} 表示为 ℛ ∘ X \mathcal{R}\circ X。

sents.en: Given a single test t t and a codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} , executing t t on ℛ \mathcal{R} results in either pass or fail.
sents.zh: 给定单个测试 t 和代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R}，在 ℛ \mathcal{R} 上执行 t 的结果只能是通过或失败。

sents.en: We define this execution as exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ) ∈ { P , F } \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})\in\{P,F\} , where P P and F F denote passing and failing outcomes, respectively.
sents.zh: 我们将此执行定义为 exec⁡(t,ℛ)∈{P,F} \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})\in\{P,F\}，其中 P 和 F 分别表示通过和失败的结果。

sents.en: A generated test t t successfully reproduces issue I I on codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} if it fails on the original code (i.e., exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ) = F \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})=F ) but passes on the patched codebase (i.e., exec ⁡ ( t , ℛ ∘ X ) = P \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R}\circ X)=P ).
sents.zh: 如果生成的测试 t 在原始代码上失败（即 exec⁡(t,ℛ)=F \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R})=F），但在补丁后的代码库上通过（即 exec⁡(t,ℛ∘X)=P \mathrm{exec}(t,\mathcal{R}\circ X)=P），则 t 成功复现了代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R} 中的问题 I。

sents.en: We refer to such a test as a fail-to-pass ( F → P F\rightarrow P ) test.
sents.zh: 我们将此类测试称为“失败转通过”（F→P F\rightarrow P）测试。

sents.en: For a generated test set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , we consider the issue successfully reproduced if 𝒯 \mathcal{T} contains at least one F → P F\rightarrow P test and all generated tests pass on the patched codebase.
sents.zh: 对于一个生成的测试集 𝒯 \mathcal{T}，如果 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 至少包含一个 F→P F\rightarrow P 测试，且所有生成的测试在补丁后的代码库上均通过，则我们认为该问题已成功复现。

paragraphs.en: We use 2,132 issue-resolution instances from Multi-SWE-Bench ( Zan et al., 2025 ) to construct Multi-SWT-Bench . These instances are derived from real-world GitHub issues and their corresponding issue-resolving pull requests. Each source instance provides the issue description, the pre-fix codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} , the issue-resolving code changes ( golden patch X ∗ X^{*} ), and the developer-written tests introduced with the fix ( golden reference tests T ∗ T^{*} ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Multi-SWE-Bench（Zan 等人，2025）中的 2,132 个问题解决实例来构建 Multi-SWT-Bench。 这些实例源自真实的 GitHub 问题及其对应的问题解决拉取请求。 每个源实例都提供了问题描述、修复前的代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R}、用于解决问题代码变更（黄金补丁 X ∗ X^{*}），以及开发者随修复一同编写的测试（黄金参考测试 T ∗ T^{*}）。

sents.en: We use 2,132 issue-resolution instances from Multi-SWE-Bench ( Zan et al., 2025 ) to construct Multi-SWT-Bench .
sents.zh: 我们使用 Multi-SWE-Bench（Zan 等人，2025）中的 2,132 个问题解决实例来构建 Multi-SWT-Bench。

paragraphs.en: Starting from these issue-resolution instances, we construct Multi-SWT-Bench in two steps: task conversion and instance validation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些问题解决实例，我们通过两个步骤构建 Multi-SWT-Bench：任务转换和实例验证。

paragraphs.en: (1) Task conversion. For each source instance, we retain the issue description and the pre-fix codebase ℛ \mathcal{R} as inputs and change the generation target from a code patch to a test set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . Generated tests are executed on both ℛ \mathcal{R} and the codebase after applying the golden patch ℛ ∘ X ∗ \mathcal{R}\circ X^{*} . A generated test reproduces the issue when it fails on the pre-fix codebase and passes after the fix, following the F → P F\rightarrow P criterion defined in Section 2.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 任务转换。 对于每个源实例，我们保留问题描述和修复前的代码库 ℛ \mathcal{R} 作为输入，并将生成目标从代码补丁更改为测试集 𝒯 \mathcal{T}。 生成的测试会在 ℛ \mathcal{R} 以及应用了黄金补丁 ℛ ∘ X ∗ \mathcal{R}\circ X^{*} 后的代码库上执行。 如果某个生成的测试在修复前的代码库上失败，但在修复后通过，则根据第 2.1 节中定义的 F → P 标准，该测试可复现该问题。

paragraphs.en: (2) Instance validation. We validate whether the developer-written golden reference tests T ∗ T^{*} provide a reliable oracle for the reproduction test generation task. paragraphs.en: Multi-SWT-Bench contains 1,963 reproduction test generation instances from 51 repositories across eight programming languages, with at least 111 instances per language (Table 1 ). As shown in Table 2 , the benchmark spans substantial variation in issue context, repository scale, and reference-test characteristics; for example, the average repository size ranges from 93K to 994K lines of code across languages. The golden reference tests contain 17.3 test cases per instance on average, of which 15.1 (approximately 87%) exhibit the F → P F\rightarrow P behavior, indicating that most directly distinguish the buggy version from the issue-resolving version. These characteristics provide a diverse multilingual evaluation set spanning different software ecosystems and task contexts.
paragraphs.zh: Multi-SWT-Bench 包含来自 51 个仓库、涵盖八种编程语言的 1,963 个复现测试生成实例，每种语言至少包含 111 个实例（表 1）。 如表 2 所示，该基准测试涵盖了问题上下文、仓库规模以及参考测试特征的显著差异；例如，不同语言中仓库的平均代码行数从 93,000 行到 994,000 行不等。 黄金参考测试平均每例包含 17.3 个测试用例，其中 15.1 个（约 87%）表现出 F → P F\rightarrow P 行为，表明大多数测试能够直接区分出存在问题的版本与解决问题后的版本。 这些特征构成了一个多样化的多语言评估集，覆盖了不同的软件生态系统和任务场景。

paragraphs.en: Methods. We evaluate four representative methods for reproduction test generation: MSWE-agent 5 5 5 https://github.com/multi-swe-bench/MSWE-agent , MOpenHands 6 6 6 https://github.com/multi-swe-bench/MopenHands , Codex 7 7 7 https://openai.com/codex/ , and Claude Code 8 8 8 https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code . MSWE-agent and MOpenHands are issue-resolution agents used in Multi-SWE-Bench ( Zan et al., 2025 ) , whereas Codex and Claude Code are general-purpose coding agents. We adapt all four methods to reproduction test generation.

paragraphs.en: MSWE-agent : MSWE-agent is built to support multilingual adoption based on SWE-agent 9 9 9 https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , which is an agent-based approach that solves issues through multi-turn interactions via a predefined agent-computer interface. We replace its issue-resolution prompts with prompts for reproduction test generation and extend its execution harness to use the repository-specific configurations provided by Multi-SWT-Bench .
paragraphs.zh: MSWE-agent：MSWE-agent 基于 SWE-agent 9 9 9 https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024）构建，旨在支持多语言应用。SWE-agent 是一种基于智能体的方法，通过预定义的智能体-计算机接口进行多轮交互来解决各类问题。 我们将原有的问题解决提示替换为用于生成复现测试的提示，并扩展其执行框架，以使用 Multi-SWT-Bench 提供的特定仓库配置。

paragraphs.en: LLMs. For MSWE-agent and MOpenHands, which access LLMs through usage-based APIs, inference cost is an important practical constraint at the scale of our evaluation. We therefore select competitive models from multiple providers and price tiers to cover different cost–performance trade-offs. Codex and Claude Code are evaluated under subscription plans. For these methods, we include models shared with MSWE-agent and MOpenHands to enable cross-method comparison, as well as the more capable models available through their respective plans (GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5) to broaden the range of models evaluated within our experimental budget.

paragraphs.en: Following SWT-Bench ( Mündler et al., 2024 ) , we adopt three metrics to evaluate the performance of any method: success rate ( 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ), change coverage ( Δ ​ 𝒞 \Delta\mathcal{C} ), and patch well-formedness ( 𝒲 \mathcal{W} ).
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 SWT-Bench（Mündler 等人，2024），我们采用三项指标来评估任何方法的性能：成功率（𝒮 \mathcal{S}）、变更覆盖度（Δ ​ 𝒞 \Delta\mathcal{C}）以及补丁格式正确性（𝒲 \mathcal{W}）。

paragraphs.en: Success Rate. We measure the success rate 𝒮 \mathcal{S} as the proportion of instances in which the generated test set 𝒯 \mathcal{T} successfully reproduces the reported issue, requiring at least one Fail-to-Pass ( F → P F\rightarrow P ) test and no test that fails after applying the golden patch ( × → F \times\rightarrow F ). We additionally report the proportions of instances for which the generated test set contains at least one Fail-to-Pass ( F → P F\rightarrow P ), Fail-to-Any ( F → × F\rightarrow\times ), and Pass-to-Pass ( P → P P\rightarrow P ) test. Here, F → × F\rightarrow\times represents a test that fails on the original codebase regardless of its outcome after applying the golden patch, while P → P P\rightarrow P represents a test that passes both before and after the patch.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate reproduction test generation performance on Multi-SWT-Bench along two dimensions: (1) language-specific performance and (2) comparisons across LLMs and agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Multi-SWT-Bench 上从两个维度评估了重生成测试的生成性能：(1) 特定语言的性能，以及 (2) 不同大型语言模型（LLM）和智能体之间的对比。

paragraphs.en: Python is the only language whose success rate exceeds the aggregate success rate across all languages (All) for every evaluated method–LLM configuration. As shown in Table 3 , Python exceeds All across all 12 configurations, whereas other languages have at least one configuration in which its success rate does not exceed All. A similar advantage for Python has also been reported in issue resolution ( Zan et al., 2025 ) and multilingual code generation ( Ivanova et al., 2026 ) . Prior work has discussed the greater representation of Python in training data and Python-oriented method design as possible contributors to this trend. Our results show that the same trend also emerges in reproduction test generation, suggesting that evaluations limited to Python may provide an overly optimistic view of reproduction test generation performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有评估的方法–LLM配置中，Python是唯一一种成功率超过所有语言（All）综合成功率的编程语言。 如表3所示，在所有12种配置中，Python的成功率均高于All，而其他语言至少存在一种配置，其成功率未能超过All。 在问题解决（Zan等，2025）和多语言代码生成（Ivanova等，2026）领域，也报告了Python具有类似的优势。 先前的研究指出，训练数据中Python的更高占比以及面向Python的方法设计，可能是导致这一趋势的部分原因。 我们的研究结果表明，在复现测试生成中同样出现了这一趋势，这意味着仅针对Python的评估可能会使我们对复现测试生成性能产生过于乐观的看法。

paragraphs.en: C++ exhibits particularly low success rates across the evaluated method–LLM configurations. Table 3 shows that Go and C++ are the only languages whose success rates remain below All across all 12 configurations. Among these two languages, C++ achieves a lower success rate than Go in nine of the 12 configurations. Even Claude Code + Claude Opus 5, which achieves the highest overall success rate, achieves only 52.50% on C++. Characteristics of the C++ instances may partly explain this lower success rate. paragraphs.en: For every LLM evaluated with multiple methods, MOpenHands achieves the highest success rate. Table 4 compares four LLMs evaluated with multiple methods: GPT-5.6 Luna, Claude Sonnet 5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. MOpenHands achieves the highest success rate for each of these LLMs. A similar tendency for MOpenHands to achieve strong performance has also been reported for issue resolution ( Zan et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that its effectiveness extends to reproduction test generation. One possible explanation is that MOpenHands and MSWE-agent interact with repositories differently. MOpenHands can execute general-purpose commands and revise its actions based on execution feedback, whereas MSWE-agent uses a more structured interface ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . This flexibility may help MOpenHands generate tests that correctly reproduce reported issues across different repositories.

paragraphs.en: For MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code, a key challenge is generating tests whose failures are resolved by the golden patch. Figure 1 shows how instances progress through three stages: generating at least one test that fails on the buggy version (F → ⁣ × \rightarrow\times ), generating at least one test that fails on the buggy version and passes after applying the golden patch (F → \rightarrow P), and ultimately satisfying the success criterion. For MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code, all evaluated LLMs trigger at least one failure on the buggy version in more than 80% of instances, but their F → \rightarrow P rates are 9.71 to 28.53 percentage points lower than their corresponding F → ⁣ × \rightarrow\times rates. In contrast, with MSWE-agent, the rate of triggering at least one failure ranges from 25.59% to 75.59% across LLMs, indicating that merely triggering a failure is itself a challenge for some LLMs under this method.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 MOpenHands、Codex 和 Claude Code 而言，一个关键挑战是生成测试用例，其失败问题能够通过黄金补丁得到解决。 图 1 展示了实例如何依次经历三个阶段：生成至少一个在错误版本中失败的测试用例（F → ×），生成至少一个在错误版本中失败但在应用黄金补丁后通过的测试用例（F → P），并最终满足成功标准。 对于 MOpenHands、Codex 和 Claude Code，所有被评估的 LLM 在超过 80% 的实例中都会在错误版本上触发至少一次失败，但它们的 F → P 比率比相应的 F → × 比率低 9.71 至 28.53 个百分点。 相比之下，使用 MSWE-agent 时，触发至少一次失败的比率在不同 LLM 之间从 25.59% 到 75.59% 不等，这表明对于某些 LLM 而言，仅凭触发失败本身在这一方法下就是一个挑战。

paragraphs.en: Programming-language and ecosystem-specific testing conventions can cause reproduction test generation failures (Appendix C.1.1 ). In Rust, 18 of the 45 issues involve CLI output or diagnostics, making it important to align the command options used in a test with the output expected by that test. For example, in ripgrep #1642 , the agent expected line-numbered output without enabling the command option that displays line numbers, so the test still failed after applying the golden patch. In Java, reusing existing helpers or fixtures can introduce conditions not required by the issue. For example, in Jackson Databind #1923 , the reused helper checks for a specific exception message that is not required by the issue, causing the test to fail even after the reported problem is fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 特定编程语言和生态系统的测试惯例可能导致复现测试生成失败（附录 C.1.1）。 在 Rust 中，45 个问题中有 18 个涉及 CLI 输出或诊断信息，因此将测试中使用的命令选项与测试期望的输出保持一致至关重要。 例如，在 ripgrep #1642 中，智能体期望输出包含行号，但并未启用显示行号的命令选项，因此即使应用了黄金补丁，测试仍然失败。 在 Java 中，重复使用现有的辅助工具或测试框架可能会引入问题本身并不需要的条件。 例如，在 Jackson Databind #1923 中，重复使用的辅助工具检查了一个问题本身并不需要的特定异常消息，导致即使已修复所报告的问题，测试仍然失败。

paragraphs.en: A test that correctly reproduces an issue can still lead to test generation failure by affecting existing tests (Appendix C.1.2 ). In C++, test-framework projects such as Catch2 can use repository-specific validation workflows in which newly added tests also affect existing tests. For example, Catch2 #2719 reports a case where an unexpected exception is not correctly reported as a test failure. The agent generated four tests for this behavior, all of which passed after applying the golden patch. However, Catch2 also has an existing test that runs many tests together and compares their combined output with saved expected output. The newly added tests changed this output, causing the existing test to fail even after applying the golden patch and making the entire test set Non-success.
paragraphs.zh: 一个能正确复现问题的测试，仍可能因影响现有测试而导致测试生成失败（附录 C.1.2）。 在 C++ 中，像 Catch2 这样的测试框架项目可以使用特定于仓库的验证流程，其中新添加的测试也会影响现有测试。 例如，Catch2 #2719 报告了一个意外异常未被正确报告为测试失败的案例。 智能体为此行为生成了四个测试，在应用黄金补丁后，所有测试均通过。 然而，Catch2 还有一个现有测试，它会同时运行多个测试，并将它们的组合输出与保存的预期输出进行比较。 新添加的测试改变了这一输出，导致即使应用了黄金补丁，该现有测试仍然失败，并使整个测试集变为非成功状态。

paragraphs.en: Even when an issue provides concrete inputs and reproduction steps, directly translating them into a test may not reproduce the bug (Appendix C.2.1 ). For example, Day.js #1022 reports an incorrect relative-time result for a specific date and provides both the input date and the expected output. However, reproducing the bug also requires controlling the current time and enabling the relevant plugins in the test environment. This example highlights that reproduction test generation requires not only translating the reported behavior into assertions, but also identifying and instantiating the environmental conditions under which that behavior occurs.
paragraphs.zh: 即使问题提供了具体的输入和复现步骤，直接将其转化为测试也未必能复现该错误（附录 C.2.1）。 例如，Day.js #1022 报告了特定日期下相对时间计算结果不正确，并提供了输入日期和预期输出。 然而，要复现该错误，还需要在测试环境中控制当前时间并启用相关插件。 这个例子表明，生成复现测试不仅需要将被报告的行为转化为断言，还需要识别并实例化导致该行为出现的环境条件。

paragraphs.en: A reproduction test can lose its intended behavior or executability after subsequent revisions (Appendix C.2.2 ). In Express #3695 , the agent first created a test that reproduced the reported failure on the buggy version successfully. However, after revising the test to satisfy the project’s lint rules, the test no longer exercised the behavior described in the issue and still failed after applying the golden patch. Similarly, in Ponyc #1051 , the agent initially created a test that failed on the buggy version, but a later edit introduced a duplicate test definition and prevented the final test suite from compiling. These cases show that subsequent revisions can invalidate a previously working reproduction test and lead to test generation failure.
paragraphs.zh: 在后续修订之后，复现测试可能会失去其预期的行为或可执行性（附录 C.2.2）。 在 Express #3695 中，智能体首先创建了一个能够成功在存在缺陷的版本上复现所报告故障的测试。 然而，在修改该测试以符合项目的 lint 规则后，该测试不再触发问题描述中的行为，并且在应用黄金补丁后仍然失败。 类似地，在 Ponyc #1051 中，智能体最初创建了一个在存在缺陷的版本上会失败的测试，但后续的一次编辑引入了重复的测试定义，导致最终的测试套件无法编译。 这些案例表明，后续修订可能会使先前有效的复现测试失效，并导致测试生成失败。

paragraphs.en: Code-Related Benchmarks for LLMs. A wide range of benchmarks has been developed to evaluate the capabilities and limitations of LLMs on code-related tasks. Early benchmarks primarily focused on program-level tasks in a single programming language ( Allamanis and Sutton, 2013 ; Raychev et al., 2016 ; Iyer et al., 2018 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . As LLMs have advanced, code-related benchmarks have increasingly moved toward evaluation settings that better reflect real-world software engineering, particularly along two dimensions: multilingual evaluation and repository-level evaluation . For multilingual evaluation, Multilingual-HumanEval ( Athiwaratkun et al., 2022 ) and HumanEval-X ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) extend HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) to multiple programming languages, while MBXP ( Athiwaratkun et al., 2022 ) provides a multilingual extension of MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) . To evaluate LLMs in more complex scenarios, benchmarks have expanded from program-level tasks to repository-level tasks that require reasoning about dependencies and interactions across multiple files, including code completion ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Ding et al., 2023 ) , bug fixing ( Mündler et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2024 ; Saavedra et al., 2024 ) , and unit test generation ( Quang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 面向大语言模型（LLM）的代码相关基准测试。 为了评估大语言模型在代码相关任务中的能力与局限性，目前已开发出多种多样的基准测试。 早期的基准测试主要聚焦于单一编程语言中的程序级任务（Allamanis and Sutton, 2013；Raychev et al., 2016；Iyer et al., 2018；Chen et al., 2021；Austin et al., 2021；Wang et al., 2023）。 随着大语言模型的发展，代码相关基准测试逐渐转向更贴近真实世界软件工程实践的评价场景，尤其体现在两个维度：多语言评估与仓库级评估。 在多语言评估方面，Multilingual-HumanEval（Athiwaratkun et al., 2022）和HumanEval-X（Zheng et al., 2023）将HumanEval（Chen et al., 2021）扩展至多种编程语言，而MBXP（Athiwaratkun et al., 2022）则提供了对MBPP（Austin et al., 2021）的多语言扩展。 为了在更复杂的场景下评估大语言模型，基准测试已从程序级任务扩展至仓库级任务，这些任务需要推理多个文件之间的依赖关系与交互作用，包括代码补全（Zhang et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2024；Ding et al., 2023）、错误修复（Mündler et al., 2024；Ouyang et al., 2024；Saavedra et al., 2024）以及单元测试生成（Quang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for Reproduction Test Generation. SWT-Bench ( Mündler et al., 2024 ) and TDD-Bench-Verified ( Ahmed et al., 2024 ) evaluate LLMs on reproduction test generation in Python. Both are derived from the SWE-Bench dataset ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and assess generated tests by checking whether they fail on the original code and pass after the issue has been resolved. Beyond Python, TDD-Bench-Java ( Ahmed et al., 2026 ) extends repository-level reproduction test generation to Java with 250 instances from popular open-source repositories, demonstrating the need to adapt existing approaches to the Java ecosystem. Although these benchmarks broaden language coverage, their independently constructed monolingual settings do not provide a unified view of how the same agents perform across programming ecosystems. Our dataset complements them by applying a common task definition, validation criterion, and evaluation protocol to tasks from eight programming languages, enabling consistent evaluation across language-specific subsets.

paragraphs.en: In this study, we introduce Multi-SWT-Bench , a multilingual benchmark for reproduction test generation consisting of 1,963 instances across eight programming languages. Using Multi-SWT-Bench , we evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs with four representative reproduction test generation methods. Based on our empirical results and failure analysis, we distill lessons for evaluating and developing automated approaches and discuss promising opportunities for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了 Multi-SWT-Bench，这是一个多语言基准，用于生成可复现的测试用例，包含八种编程语言中的 1,963 个实例。 我们使用 Multi-SWT-Bench，对当前最先进的 LLM 模型和四种具有代表性的可复现测试生成方法进行了评估。 基于我们的实证结果和失败分析，我们提炼出评估与开发自动化方法的经验教训，并探讨了未来研究的潜在方向。

paragraphs.en: Multilingual evaluation : Python is the only language whose success rate consistently exceeds the aggregate success rate across all evaluated configurations (Section 4.1.1 ), indicating that performance measured only on Python may not transfer to ecosystems with different build systems and testing practices. Evaluations should therefore cover diverse programming ecosystems to assess the generalizability.

paragraphs.en: Behavioral validation : Although MOpenHands, Codex, and Claude Code generate failing tests for over 80% of instances, many failures are not resolved by the golden patch (Section 4.1.2 ). Our failure analysis highlights two recurring challenges: (1) the required setup may be implicit, and (2) iterative revisions can remove the target behavior or make a previously valid test non-executable (Section 4.2.2 ). Future methods should therefore identify the expected behavioral difference between buggy and fixed versions, infer the necessary setup from the issue and repository context, and revalidate it after each revision.

paragraphs.en: To identify factors associated with reproduction test generation performance, we focus on four key factors: (1) issue type , (2) issue description characteristics , (3) fix patch characteristics , and (4) reference test characteristics .

We divide the instances into two groups: single-file executions, in which the golden reference tests execute exactly one file, and multi-file executions, in which they execute two or more files.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 13 , there is no monotonic relationship between golden reference test length and reproduction test generation performance. The success rate does not consistently decrease as the golden reference tests become longer, and intermediate-length groups sometimes achieve higher success rates than shorter groups. However, the ≥ 901 \geq 901 -token group generally shows lower success rates than the ≤ 300 \leq 300 -token group across most programming languages and agents. These results suggest that issues with relatively long golden reference tests tend to be more difficult to reproduce, although golden reference test length alone does not consistently explain reproduction test generation performance.
